step.title: Evaporation
step.objective: Explain how heat from the sun turns liquid water into water vapor.
keyPoints: The sun warms oceans, lakes and rivers.
As water heats up, some of it turns into an invisible gas called water vapor: this is evaporation.
Warm air carries the water vapor upward.
step.checkQuestion: Why does a wet T-shirt dry faster on a sunny day than on a cloudy day?

passages.text: The sun warms oceans, lakes and rivers. As the water heats up, some of it turns into an invisible gas called water vapor. This process is called evaporation.
Warm air carries the water vapor upward. Plants also release water vapor through their leaves, which adds to the moisture in the air.
